home.title: ShyTalk
home.heading: Learn languages and cultures by talking
home.intro: ShyTalk is a friendly place to practise a language out loud and discover the cultures behind it.
home.paceBody: Join a voice room, listen in, and take a seat to speak when you feel ready. Shy is welcome here.
home.peopleTitle: Learn from the people who live it.
home.peopleBody: Hear how a language is really spoken, and learn the customs, festivals and everyday life that come with it.
home.safeBody: Clear community rules keep ShyTalk supportive, and moderators enforce them. Under-18s and adults use separate spaces.
home.wayBody: The ShyTalk app is being built now. Apply for closed testing to try it early.

closedTesting.heading: Apply for closed testing
closedTesting.intro: Closed testing lets a small group try the ShyTalk app before it launches.
closedTesting.noAccess: Sending this form does not give access to closed testing.
closedTesting.moreDetails: If you are preliminarily selected, you will be asked for more details.
closedTesting.safeList: Add shytalk.app to your list of safe senders so that messages reach you.
closedTesting.removed: If you are not selected, your details are removed.
closedTesting.retention: Your details are kept only until closed testing ends.
closedTesting.adultLabel: Tick to confirm you are 18 or older
closedTesting.sent: Thank you. If this address still needs confirming, an email with a link is on its way.
closedTesting.invalid: Enter a valid email address and confirm you are 18 or older.
closedTesting.sendFailed: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.
closedTesting.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
closedTesting.noScript: This form needs JavaScript to be turned on.
closedTesting.confirmBody: Press the button to confirm this email address for closed testing.
closedTesting.confirmFailed: The email address could not be confirmed just now. Please try again later.
closedTesting.confirmedBody: Thank you. Your address is on the closed testing list.
closedTesting.expiredBody: This link has already been used or is more than 48 hours old.
closedTesting.mailSubject: Confirm your email for ShyTalk closed testing
closedTesting.mailIntro: Someone applied for ShyTalk closed testing with this address. To confirm it, open this link and press the button within 48 hours:
closedTesting.mailIgnore: If this was not you, ignore this email and the address is removed after 48 hours.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is no page at this address.

email.signUpIntro: Use this code to confirm your email address and finish joining ShyTalk:
email.recoveryIntro: Use this code to start recovering your ShyTalk account:
email.codeLife: The code works once, for 10 minutes.
email.ignore: If this was not you, ignore this email. Nothing changes without the code.
email.existsBody: Someone asked to join ShyTalk with this email address, which already has an account. Sign in with a passkey, an authenticator app, Google or Apple.
email.existsRecover: If every way to sign in is lost, recover the account here:
email.recoveryStartedSubject: Your ShyTalk account is being recovered
email.recoveryStartedBody: A recovery of your ShyTalk account has started. From {completesAt}, a new way to sign in can be added, and every other device will be signed out.
email.recoveryCancel: If this was not you, cancel the recovery now:

account.signUpIntro: Enter your email address. A 6-digit code is sent to it, to confirm the address is yours.
account.recoverIntro: If every way to sign in is lost, a code sent to your email address starts a recovery. A new way to sign in can be added 24 hours later, and the recovery can be cancelled until then.
account.sent: An email is on its way. If it holds a code, enter it here: it works once, for 10 minutes.
account.invalid: Enter a valid email address, and the code as 6 digits.
account.tooMany: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
account.sendFailed: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.
account.codeRefused: That code is not right, or it has expired. Ask for a new one if needed.
account.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
account.recoveryStarted: The recovery has started. From {completesAt}, a new way to sign in can be added on this device.
account.cancelIntro: Press the button to cancel the recovery of your ShyTalk account.
account.cancelled: Nothing is being recovered on this account now.
account.noScript: This page needs JavaScript to work.
account.chooseMethodIntro: A passkey signs you in with this phone's face or fingerprint unlock. An authenticator app shows a new 6-digit code every 30 seconds.
account.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be set up. Try again, or use an authenticator app.
account.authenticatorIntro: Add ShyTalk to your authenticator app with this setup key, or open the link on this phone. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
account.codesIntro: Each code works once, if every other way to sign in is lost. Keep them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.
account.lastMethod: This is the last way to sign in. Add another before removing it.
account.signedInFirst: You are already signed in. Sign out to continue here.
account.recoveryPending: A recovery of this account started on {startedAt}. If this was not you, cancel it now.
account.orAuthenticator: Or sign in with your authenticator app
account.signInRefused: That did not work. Check the address and the code, and try again.
account.memberBlocked: A moderation decision has blocked this account, so it cannot sign in.

holding.building: The ShyTalk app is being built now.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Ask a question or report a problem. The reply comes by email.
support.englishForm: The form is in English for now.
support.appealIntro: If you think a moderation decision on your account was wrong, explain why here.
support.noScript: The support form needs JavaScript. Turn it on to send a request.
